text: What gets costlier (and what stays high) 40% “"de-merit” band: sin & super-luxury (very narrow list) The Council okayed a 40% rate for: ¢ Tobacco products (pan masala, gutkha, cigarettes, etc.) — transition deferred: they continue at current GST+compensation-cess until the cess loans are fully repaid; 40% framework exists but timing will be notified later. e Carbonated/sugary beverages and very large engine cars (>1500cc) are flagged for the 40% bracket in the post-meeting briefings/press.
